The Book

Color your way from A to Z

Let Meet Our Animal Friends is an alphabet coloring and learning book for young readers. Inside, the greeting reads “LET’S MEET OUR ANIMAL FRIENDS!” — and every animal introduces itself the same friendly way: “Hiiii, my friend! My name is Elephant because I start with the letter E.”

It begins with an About Me page where the child writes their name, age, and favorite color. Then comes one coloring page for each letter, A to Z — a big outline letter and a large black-and-white animal illustration to color. The book closes with a thank-you page: “Thank you for coloring, learning, and meeting our animal friends… Keep exploring, keep learning, and keep coloring!”

Published as a paperback through Amazon’s Kindle Direct Publishing in November 2026, with large 8.5 × 11 inch pages made for coloring.

About the Author

Meet Marghan’sy Jean

Marghan’sy Jean is the author behind Let Meet Our Animal Friends, her A–Z coloring and learning book. She brought her book to readers by self-publishing through Amazon KDP, releasing the 28-page paperback edition on November 5, 2026.

Her verified Amazon Author Page is the best place to follow her work, find her book, and stay up to date as her author journey continues. This website is her home on the web for readers, families, and anyone who loves animal friends.

More to come — follow along on Amazon so you don’t miss what’s next.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Where can I buy Let Meet Our Animal Friends?

The paperback is available on Amazon. Use the “Buy on Amazon” buttons on this page to go straight to the book’s Amazon listing: amazon.com/dp/B0HQG5HS3V.

What kind of book is it?

It is an alphabet (ABC) coloring and learning book. Children meet one animal friend for every letter, A to Z, and color a big, friendly black-and-white illustration on each page while they learn the letter.

What’s inside the book?

The book has 28 pages. It opens with a “Hello! Let’s Meet Our Animal Friends!” page with an About Me section (name, age, and favorite color), followed by 26 coloring pages — Ant for A, Butterfly for B, Cat for C, all the way to Xerus for X, Yak for Y, and Zebra for Z. Each page says “Hiiii, my friend! My name is … because I start with the letter …” with a big outline letter. It closes with a “Thank You, Little Friend!” page celebrating coloring, learning, and meeting the animal friends.

What format is the book available in?

The verified edition is a 28-page paperback, 8.5 × 11 inches, published through Kindle Direct Publishing on November 5, 2026. Check the Amazon listing for any additional formats shown there.

How can I follow the author?

Visit Marghan’sy Jean’s Amazon Author Page at amazon.com/author/hansy and use Amazon’s follow option there to get updates about her work.

How do I get in touch about the book?

Email Marghan’sy Jean at marghansyjean@icloud.com, use the contact form below to open a draft in your email app, or reach out through the Amazon Author Page. For school, library, or event enquiries, please include a few details about your request.
